scene_prompt:
A cozy camping tent scene during a rainy afternoon in a flat vintage rubberhose cartoon style. The tent interior is warmly lit with soft golden light while rain falls outside the open tent flap onto muddy ground and puddles. Keep the composition extremely simple and easy to read with only 5 main focal groups: the camping tent interior, a small camping stove, a sleeping bag area, a snack crate, and a funny toy seahorse.

On the small camping stove: a metal popcorn pot with popcorn overflowing slightly, beside a striped red-and-yellow popcorn bowl. Nearby sits a bright blue thermos and a pair of damp rain boots with tiny muddy footprints leading into the tent. A folded orange raincoat hangs near the entrance, suggesting someone just came in from the rain.

Funny unexpected detail: a small plush seahorse wearing a tiny camping hat is propped up beside the popcorn bowl as if waiting for a snack. Another playful detail: one popped popcorn piece landed on top of the seahorse’s head.

Include around 10 clear visible details total. Use colorful objects with memorable placements and environmental storytelling strongly suggesting someone was making popcorn while hiding from the rain during a camping trip. Bright cheerful retro palette with rainy gray-blue tones outside and warm cozy light inside the tent. Clean readable silhouettes, simple shapes, minimal clutter, no text labels, no logos, no UI.
